about: Every analysis run in this project, newest last. tools/gold_tracker.py renders it into build/pdfref/GOLD_TRACKER.{html,md}. Append an entry for each new analysis.

entries.analysis: Ported the 2026 document's configuration rules (Kshin Moon, Total Days, Rahu/Ketu nakshatra on Thursday, Moon-Mercury D9, eclipses, Moon rashi parivartan, month systems, B19/B111/B116/B117, benefic/malefic valence).
entries.result: Rules print in the 2026 table layout; base layer for every later analysis.

entries.analysis: Read Tech Astro Analysis (2020) and KD 2026 in full; added every computable rule; built a New York (ET) 2027 calendar with 9 fields per event; extracted both PDFs to HTML.
entries.result: ~730 rules in the catalogue; ~1,600 major events in the 2027 NY calendar; validation 51/58 against the 2026 printed rows.

entries.analysis: Every rule that names gold / silver, 20 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027, US Eastern time, each boundary checked against the astronomy layer.
entries.result: Gold report ~205 rows, silver report 117 rows.

entries.analysis: Added the user's Sun rules: Sun in Venus/Mercury/Jupiter nakshatra (U1, rise); Venus, Mercury, Jupiter or waxing Moon with/aspecting the Sun (U2, hike); Sun in Saturn/Rahu nakshatra (U3, fall); Saturn or Rahu with/aspecting the Sun (U4, crash).
entries.result: U1-U4 in the gold report with a Sun-state timeline; conflicts with TA S34 noted on each row.

entries.analysis: Checked every silver bull/bear item in the PDFs and resources against the report.
entries.result: Added Rahu in Dhanishta (bullion risk) and Venus retrograde in Taurus; Moon-based mirror of U1-U4 NOT implemented (no source backing).

entries.analysis: Full 2026 comparison of the gold section; Indian gold-demand dates (Kindle Ch15); Abhijit span fix.
entries.result: Gold coverage complete for computable rules.

entries.analysis: Every gold rule scored against COMEX gold (GC=F) daily closes, 20 Nov 2025 - 20 Nov 2026; failure causes, biggest moves.
entries.result: 61 of 124 decided occurrences worked (49%); bearish-majority days were followed by -1.49% over 5 days; the Jan-2026 crash was not flagged by any rule.

entries.analysis: Same rule set, 20 Nov 2021 - 20 Nov 2026, with per-year drift-aware base rates, binomial p-values and per-year results.
entries.result: 288 of 554 worked (52%) vs 54% by chance; best: combined Sun model 105/179 (p=0.057), U2-Jupiter, U2-Venus, U2-Mercury right in 4 of 5 years; U4-Saturn did not hold up (6/20).

entries.analysis: Rule-status table combining the 1- and 5-year backtests; dates of the best-performing rules from 20 Nov 2026 to 31 Dec 2027; this log.

entries.topic: Silver backtest, 1 and 5 years + silver tracker
entries.analysis: Every silver rule (TA S35, other TA/KD silver items, 2026 document silver section) scored against COMEX silver (SI=F), 20 Nov 2021 - 20 Nov 2026, same method as gold; failure analysis reads the Moon (silver significator) and gold's move over the same dates. Tracker generalised: SILVER_TRACKER.
entries.result: 197 of 414 worked (48%) vs 50% by chance; net rule count pointed the wrong way; outcomes followed gold (failed 153/178 when gold moved against the rule). Best: Venus-Mars / Sun-Mars together (19/30, 4 of 5 years); 'Venus alone in Leo/Libra' 5/6 vs plain 'Venus in Leo/Libra' 3/11.

entries.topic: Review of Reference_materials/Others (45 files) + test of their gold/silver rules
entries.analysis: All 45 documents (~11,000 pages) text-extracted, 3 scanned books OCR'd, every page scanned for market content, financial sections read. New gold/silver rules (Brihat Samhita Ch.41-42 and 10.17, Timing Solutions Ch.9, the Moon-and-Silver guide) tested on COMEX closes 2000-2026.
entries.result: 8 documents have market content; only Brihat Samhita has classical gold/silver price rules. Moon->silver rulership is sourced, a Moon version of the user's Sun rules is not. Silver guide's Moon rules: no effect over 26 years; new->full Moon hold did WORSE than full->new for both metals. BS 42.14(a) weak positive for gold; BS 10.17 (Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada, gold afflicted) active until 8 Feb 2027. bayer_all_48_rules.docx rules 25-48 do not match Bayer's 1940 text.

entries.topic: Brihat Samhita gold/silver rules implemented; Bayer and Western sources excluded
entries.analysis: BS 42.14a (lunation in Aries/Capricorn with benefic: gold up), 42.14b (Sun in Aries/Capricorn with malefic: gold down), 10.17 (Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada: gold afflicted), 42.6 (Sun in Leo: store gold/silver, sell in 5th month) added as sourced rules (finastro/pdfref/bs_rules.py); reports, NY calendar, backtests and trackers regenerated. Bayer, McWhirter, Williams, Weingarten, Timing Solutions and the Moon-and-Silver guide excluded by user decision; BS 41.9-13 pending.
entries.result: Forward dates: Saturn in Uttara Bhadrapada to 7 Feb 2027 (bearish); Sun with Rahu in Capricorn 14 Jan - 12 Feb 2027 (bearish); new Moon in Capricorn aspected by Jupiter 6 Feb 2027 and full Moon in Aries 13 Nov 2027 (bullish); store window 17 Aug 2027 - 14 Jan 2028. 5-year scores: all four 'Mixed' (too few occurrences to judge).

entries.topic: Financial Astrology Model v1.0 (Brihat Samhita Ch.41 + BPHS Shadbala + Ashtakavarga) for gold
entries.analysis: Locked the user's Classical Combined Commodity Framework. Own Shadbala/Ashtakavarga implementation per BPHS Ch.27 (validated against B.V. Raman's worked example and BPHS's Ahargana example); BS 41.9-13 house rules from gold's signs (Aries, Capricorn); two indices (scarcity, demand/value), bias and confidence; daily NY-sunrise calendar 20 Nov 2026 - 31 Dec 2027 and a 2000-2026 backtest. Silver: insufficient data (no Ch.41 sign).
entries.result: Backtest 2000-2026 (6,572 days): correlation of the scarcity index with the next 5 days -0.002; 'Strong bullish' days averaged +0.04% over 5 days vs +0.24% for all days. Structural bullish skew (67% of days mild bullish or stronger). Forward: bearish stretches 16 Jun - 16 Jul 2027 (Mild bearish to Bearish); strongest bullish 1-8 Aug 2027, 23-30 Aug 2027, 16-27 Dec 2027.
